meta.parties: The Municipal Council of Colombo v. Letchiman Chettair, K.M.N.S.P.[Privy Council Decision]

rules.statement: The market value of land to be acquired is the price a willing vendor might obtain from a willing purchaser in an open market, and this must be considered first by the government agent and court when determining compensation.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 21 of the Land Acquisition Ordinance requires the government agent and court to take into consideration first the market value of the land to be acquired at the time of awarding compensation. The market value is the price which a willing vendor might be expected to obtain in the open market from a willing purchaser"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 21 of the Land Acquisition Ordinance (cap.203)
